_comment_config: This is a configuration template. Customize these values for your deployment before running the installer.

asm._ssoCallbackUrls_comment: Optional. Redirect URI(s) of the ASM portal OIDC login; when set, an AsmPortalSsoClient is created on the admin user pool and scripts/asm-sso-params.sh prints the OIDC parameters to hand to the ASM operator.

billing._comment: Optional. 722lic.works Licensing for tenant self-signup. apiKey is written to Secrets Manager apersona/billing/apikey; use an Product Line-scoped key pinned to this deployment NAT IP.

signup._comment: Optional. Tenant self-signup registration API keys, written to Secrets Manager apersona/signup/apikey. allowedIps: CIDRs of the registration service; a key with no allowedIps never authorizes.

_schema.description: Bootstrap configuration for initial tenant deployment
notes: This file is used ONLY on first deployment
After first deployment, all tenant management is done via Admin Portal UI
Fill in all required fields before running install-multi-tenants.sh
Do NOT commit this file with real credentials to a public repository
